items.title: Canadian 'crypto king' case to go to jury as criminal trial winds down
items.summary: Aiden Pleterski, facing fraud charges in Canada over his alleged role in a digital asset Ponzi scheme, said that he was innocent at closing.

items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Sam Bankman-Fried wrote to actor portraying him in Netflix series
items.summary: The former FTX CEO remains incarcerated as Irish actor Anthony Boyle portrays him in a series about the downfall of the crypto exchange and his relationship with Caroline Ellison.

items.title: Strategy shareholders approve daily dividends for four preferred stocks
items.summary: The largest Bitcoin treasury company will begin daily dividend payments on STRC in November, with three other preferred securities following in January 2027.

items.title: Crypto PAC spending before midterms possibly obscured after reported FEC hack
items.summary: The FEC reported an "electronic filing system outage" on Tuesday as groups are expected to ramp up spending before the US midterm elections.

items.title: Bitcoin price bounce rejected at 50-day trend line ahead of FOMC, earnings
items.summary: Bitcoin failed to move past its 50-day simple moving average as market participants awaited the outcome of the FOMC meeting and key tech earnings.

items.title: Bitcoin Treasury Datavault AI Says It Can't Access Its BTC, Stock Tanks
items.summary: Datavault AI says it has been unable to withdraw its Bitcoin from Biconomy since June and will restate four financial reports tied to a $150 million Scilex deal.

items.title: Chip Maker SK Hynix Posts Record Quarter as AI Memory Demand Overwhelms Supply
items.summary: SK Hynix's quarterly revenue topped 100 trillion won for the first time, and the chipmaker says memory demand will outrun supply through 2030, with DRAM and HBM sold out through 2029.

items.title: AI Security Startup Upwind Raises $400M at $3.8B Valuation
items.summary: The cloud and AI security firm Upwind says revenue quadrupled in 2026 as it targets risks from autonomous AI agents.

items.title: More Americans Have Tried Crypto, But Few Are Sticking With It: Survey
items.summary: A survey conducted by Ipsos for the DeFi Education Fund found that 22% of Americans have ever owned or used crypto, up from 18%, while past-year use held flat at 13%.

items.title: OpenAI Plans to Buy Google's AI Chips as It Looks Beyond Nvidia: Report
items.summary: OpenAI, one of Nvidia's biggest customers, reportedly plans to buy Google's TPU chips. Neither company has confirmed the report, and the price and size of the order were not disclosed.

items.title: Fed Stands Pat, Bitcoin Holds Steady-But a December Rate Hike Is in Play
items.summary: The Federal Reserve left rates unchanged Wednesday in a 10-2 vote, with Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack favoring a hike.

items.title: Robinhood earnings miss, crypto weakness fail to shake Wall Street's bullish outlook
items.summary: Bernstein sees Robinhood's crypto business shifting toward infrastructure as new products like prediction markets and perps gain ground.

items.title: Bitwise raises bitcoin price target to $1.6 million by 2036, projects 34% annualized returns
items.summary: Bitwise's bear case puts bitcoin at $130,686 by 2036, while its bull case reaches $3.67 million over the next decade.

items.title: Coinbase adds Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin across retail, exchange and Prime platforms
items.summary: RLUSD is live on Coinbase with 1:1 USD conversion on XRP Ledger, Ethereum and Base, capping a big week of news for Ripple.

items.title: Avail launches ShieldTX privacy tool targeting copy-trading bots on Hyperliquid
items.summary: Avail launched ShieldTX, a Hyperliquid privacy tool that creates a separate wallet for each perpetual futures position.

items.title: Crypto braces for potential shift in congressional oversight after midterms
items.summary: Post-Clarity Act, the crypto sector could find itself navigating a very different political landscape under a new Congress.

items.title: Ripple expects $900 million annualized product revenue run rate as institutional business expands
items.summary: Ripple expects a $900M annualized product revenue run rate by end of 2026, as RLUSD reaches $2.5B and payments near $150B in lifetime volume.
